nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S$ be a unital $*$-subalgebra of the algebra $M_n(\mathbb{C})$ of complex $n \times n$ matrices. Then the commutant of the commutant of $S$ equals $S$: a matrix commutes with every matrix that commutes with all elements of $S$ if and only if it lies in $S$.
nodes.title: Finite-dimensional bicommutant theorem

nodes.summary: Let $H$ be a complex Hilbert space and let $S$ be a unital $*$-subalgebra of the algebra of bounded linear operators on $H$. Write $S'$ for the commutant of $S$, the set of bounded operators on $H$ that commute with every element of $S$.
